name: paper-spirit-zine
title_zh: 原片还在，下面铺一层纸
tagline_zh: 照片为主，下半场变成可触的纸面刊物
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into a tactile Paper Spirit Zine poster where the original photograph remains emotionally primary and the lower paper field becomes a source-derived living afterimage: ridge, shoreline, shadow, wind trace, breath mark, or only-if-earned animal-like vessel. Use for photo-to-zine editorial posters, paper afterimages, photographic memory specimens, Douyin-ready art ser
why_zh: 原照情绪不让位，下面那块纸才是第二句话。
limit_zh: 不是把原片画没。要完全抽象，去装蒸馏那一件。
